ResearchProjectDef.label: autofarmer kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked autofarmer back into crude service. Needs a wrecked autofarmer that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked autofarmer where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: autofarmer refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to bring a kludged autofarmer close to what it was. This is not the original engineering, which its makers already solved. It is the colony's own hard-won knowledge of how to bring a dead one back. Needs a kludged autofarmer that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged autofarmer where it stands. It needs an ancient component.
